upstream.description: A curated collection of social media scraping APIs and tools for Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and more. Extract posts, profiles, videos, comments, and engagement metrics.

classification.analysis: A thin curated list pointing to third-party scraping APIs and Apify actors for extracting posts, profiles, videos, comments, and engagement metrics from Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook. It appears to be a promotional/lead-gen repo tied to a paid course (skool.com link) with almost no original code — just README content, a follow-creator prompt, and a small script to fetch Apify actor listings. No substantive implementation or documentation was found beyond the top-level tree.

use_cases.title: Find a third-party API for scraping a specific social platform
Browse Apify actors for social media data extraction
